g.text: Newer-route point estimates move in both directions
Exploratory release-period view · markers are observed points; lines only connect them · route, architecture, and size can change
Result: Qwen point estimates rise on five endpoints and fall on consequence METEOR; DeepSeek endpoint movement is also mixed.
Accuracy panels share one scale; METEOR is separate. Gemma is blocked; DeepSeek relevance ends 2025 Q4. No intervals; ValuePrism predicts synthetic/GPT-4 labels.
